bayts.text: O Lord, by the Chosen, the Elect of Muḍar, intercessor of his community in desert and town,
bless him with peace without number, in the Family and the Companions, and protect us from harm.
Keep the community of the Chosen from what draws to them other than worship, and protect them from the sparks (of evil).
And turn Satan toward others than them forever, and spare them whoever assaults among men.
And turn sickness away from the sick of all, through him, and turn toward them what brings safety and glad tidings.
And place the hearts of the people of Islām in safety, and spare them all that leads to peril.
And bless always with peace, upon him, with those affiliated to him; and bestow clarity and pearls.
